Zuidwest — Utrecht, Netherlands

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Kanaleneiland and Transwijk, south-west of the centre. Second in Utrecht's 2025 count of police registrations for youth nuisance, at 609. Utrecht publishes police registrations and survey results by wijk through its own research office. Registered crime across the city rose 10% in 2025, driven by home burglary, thefts from cars, bicycle theft and violence, and 59% of residents reported seeing at least one suspicious situation in their neighbourhood that year. Residential and well away from the canals visitors come for.

Frequently asked questions

Is Zuidwest safe?

Wandroz currently rates Zuidwest in Utrecht as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Utrecht during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Utrecht at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Utrecht publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Zuidwest safe at night?

At night, Zuidwest is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Utrecht. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Zuidwest a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Zuidwest's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Utrecht) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Zuidwest?

Not an official government crime feed — Zuidwest's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know Zuidwest well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
